_readme: The operator's language. English is the SOURCE — every other locale falls back to it,
key by key, so a partial translation is a working translation.
TO TRANSLATE: copy the keys you want into yo.json / sw.json / ha.json and translate the
VALUES. Leave a key out and it simply stays English. You never touch a .svelte file.
{braces} are placeholders and must survive translation — {reference} becomes 'John 3:16'.
Word order may change freely; the placeholder just has to still be there.
This is the LIVE surface first: the screens a volunteer uses under pressure, in a dark
booth, with a congregation waiting. Settings and the Library are still English and that
is a deliberate order, not an oversight — a half-translated app that covers the Sunday
path beats a complete one that ships next year.
